caption:
Stamp DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL on any PDF 🖋️

1️⃣ Open pdf.315tools.com and pick Watermark
2️⃣ Type your text, then choose layout, size, color and opacity
3️⃣ Press Add watermark and save

Tip: repeated text is harder to crop out than one line in the middle. Your file never leaves your device.
